Hong Kong passport photo at home

Take a Hong Kong passport photo with your phone for free. The camera guides you to the official 40×50 mm format with a plain white background, checks the result, and never uploads your photo.

Hong Kong passport photo rules

Photo size
40×50 mm
Head height
32–36 mm, measured chin to top of hair
Background
Plain white
Online upload
At least 1200×1600 pixels
Glasses
Allowed in some cases (no glare or tint, eyes clearly visible). Removing them is safest.
Notes
Glasses ok if frame clear of eyes, no glare. Optional photo-taking at ImmD submission kiosks (height 1.25-1.90 m). Upload JPEG <=5MB.

Checked against the official Hong Kong rules in November 2026. Rules change, so check that page before you apply. The exact wording behind each value is in the evidence file.

Tips for a photo that passes

  • Stand about 60 cm (2 ft) in front of a plain, light wall, facing a window or soft light.
  • Have someone else take it with the back camera from about 1.2 m (4 ft) away. Arm's-length selfies can distort your face.
  • Keep a neutral face with your mouth closed and both eyes open, looking straight at the lens.
  • Remove hats, headphones and anything covering your face.
  • Use the saved JPEG for online applications, or print the 4×6 in (10×15 cm) sheet at 100% scale and cut along the lines.
